Worktree (this is your working directory, an isolated git worktree — do NOT cd elsewhere and do NOT touch the main checkout):
E:\Projects\Code\AI\Ji\.gold-band\worktrees\task-025\run-001\dyn-70d25b9db7a593c0

Read these first:
- AGENTS.md (project rules) and its routed rule files docs/rules/ui-interaction.md, docs/rules/state-lifecycle-and-data-integrity.md, docs/rules/data-loading.md
- docs/java-rewrite/18-client-orchestration.md §1, §4, §9, §11 (context for why this exists)
- ji-java/web/app/src/App.tsx (SettingsPage + ProviderProfileEditor are the models to follow)

## Fixed REST contract (implemented by me in Java in parallel — do NOT change it, do NOT edit any Java file)

- `GET /api/v1/host` already returns `hostId`, `workspaceId`, `protocolVersion`, `hcpWebSocketUrl`, `capabilities`. It now ALSO returns `hostIdRevision` (number).
- NEW: `POST /api/v1/host/identity` with JSON body `{"expectedRevision": <number>, "hostId": "<new id>"}`.
  - 200 → `{"hostId": "<canonical id>", "hostIdRevision": <number>}`
  - 400 → error code `host.identity_invalid`, parameters `{hostId, reason}`
  - 409 → error code `host.identity_revision_conflict`, parameters `{expectedRevision, currentRevision}`
  - 403 → `permission.denied`
  - The response is the authoritative canonical value; the UI MUST adopt the returned `hostId`/`hostIdRevision`, never assume the submitted value won.
  - Id is accepted as `[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,127}`.
- Error payload shape: follow exactly how the existing credential flows surface `credential.revision_conflict` / `credential.value_invalid` in api.ts + components + i18n. Reuse that same mechanism and error-code plumbing; do not invent a parallel error channel.

## Deliverable (minimal slice, no extra scope)

1. `ji-java/web/app/src/lib/api.ts`: add the typed call for `GET /api/v1/host` (if not already present — check how `api.providerProfiles()` is written and match the style) and for the rename POST. Keep types in `src/lib/types.ts` if that is where host types live.
2. `App.tsx` `SettingsPage` for `scope === "Host"`: add a "Host identity" section that
   - displays the current canonical `hostId` (and its revision),
   - lets the user type a new id and submit to rename,
   - shows loading / saved / error states in place, mapping `host.identity_invalid` and `host.identity_revision_conflict` to localized messages (revision conflict must re-read the latest canonical identity and let the user retry),
   - is disabled/read-only when `remote` is true (the `remote` prop already exists on SettingsPage) — remote/Relay-driven views must not offer a Host-identity rename,
   - adopts the canonical response value on success and invalidates/refreshes the host query.
3. i18n: add keys to BOTH `en` and `zh-CN` in `ji-java/web/app/src/lib/i18n.tsx` with identical variable contracts (the existing `i18n-catalog.test.ts` checks symmetry — read it and keep it passing). All user-visible text must go through `t(...)`; no hardcoded strings.
4. Components: use the existing shadcn/ui components in `src/components/ui/` and the existing design tokens/classes. Do NOT hand-roll inputs or dialogs if a shadcn/ui component exists. Do NOT add new dependencies.
5. Accessibility per docs/rules/ui-interaction.md: real `<label>`/`aria-label` naming, keyboard operable, focus preserved, errors announced via `role="alert"`, colour not the only status signal.
6. Tests: add a focused vitest test (match the style of existing `*.test.tsx`, e.g. `credential-secret-field.test.tsx`) covering: success adopts the canonical returned id; invalid-id error renders a localized message; revision conflict re-reads and allows retry; the rename control is absent/disabled when `remote` is true. Use the existing test-setup and mocking patterns.

## Constraints

- Do NOT edit any Java, Gradle, `.md`, `.json` contract, or generated file. TypeScript/TSX under `ji-java/web/app/src/` only.
- Do NOT run `git add`, `git commit`, `pnpm build`, `vite build`, or any `gradlew` command. I run those.
- You MAY run: `corepack pnpm --filter '@ji/web-app' test` and `corepack pnpm --filter '@ji/web-app' exec tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json` from the repo root (run pnpm from the repo root; `node_modules` is already installed offline).
- If `tsc --noEmit` is not expressible with this project's tsconfig, run `corepack pnpm --filter '@ji/web-app' exec tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit` and report exactly what you ran.
- Minimal correct change: no refactors of unrelated code, no new abstraction layers, no compatibility branches.
- Do not read, print, or write secrets (`.env`, API keys, SSH keys). Never print file contents of `.env`.

When done, reply with a concise report: files changed (paths), the exact commands you ran, their results, any test that fails and why, and anything you deliberately left out.

Implementation is complete and green. Final report:

## Files changed

**Modified**
- `E:\Projects\Code\AI\Ji\.gold-band\worktrees\task-025\run-001\dyn-70d25b9db7a593c0\ji-java\web\app\src\lib\types.ts` — added `HostIdentity {hostId, hostIdRevision}` and `HostInfo = HostIdentity & {workspaceId, protocolVersion, hcpWebSocketUrl, capabilities}`.
- `...\ji-java\web\app\src\lib\api.ts` — `host()` now typed `HostInfo` (the inline literal gained `hostIdRevision` transitively); new `renameHost(expectedRevision, hostId)` → `POST /api/v1/host/identity` with body `{expectedRevision, hostId}`, returning `HostIdentity`. Reuses the existing `request()`/`ApiProblem` plumbing.
- `...\ji-java\web\app\src\lib\i18n.tsx` — 11 new keys in **both** `en` and `zh-CN` (`hostIdentity`, `hostIdentityDetail`, `hostIdHint`, `renameHost`, `hostIdentityRenamed{hostId}`, `hostIdentityInvalid`, `hostIdentityRevisionConflict{currentRevision}`, `hostIdentityDenied`, `hostIdentityRemote`, `hostIdentityLoadFailed`, `hostIdentitySaveFailed`). Placeholders are symmetric; no hardcoded strings in the component.
- `...\ji-java\web\app\src\App.tsx` — 2 lines: import + `<HostIdentityField remote={remote} />` as the first section of `SettingsPage` for `scope === "Host"` (route `/settings/hosts/:hostId/:tab`).

**New**
- `...\ji-java\web\app\src\components\host-identity-field.tsx` — the Host identity section.
- `...\ji-java\web\app\src\components\host-identity-field.test.tsx` — 5 tests.

## Behaviour implemented
- Reads `GET /api/v1/host` through the shared `["host"]` query (same key as `App`, so no second request) with `enabled: !remote`; shows canonical `hostId` + `Revision N`.
- Rename CASes on the revision last read; on 200 it **adopts the returned `hostId`/`hostIdRevision`** (`setQueryData`) and then invalidates/refreshes `["host"]`, so a Host-canonicalized id wins over the typed text. Draft state is `null` = "follow canonical", so the field always converges to the authoritative id.
- Error codes mapped like the credential flow (`data-error-code` + `role="alert"` + error-key table): `host.identity_invalid` → localized rejection (draft kept, `aria-invalid`), `host.identity_revision_conflict` → localized message interpolating `{currentRevision}` **and** a canonical re-read (`refetch`) so the retry CASes against the new revision, `permission.denied` → dedicated message, anything else → `hostIdentitySaveFailed`.
- `remote` (Relay) renders no input, no submit and no `role="status"`, and never calls `GET /api/v1/host` — required, since existing App tests assert zero REST on `/settings/hosts/remote-host/general`.
- A11y: real wrapping `<label>` named from `t("hostId")`, hint wired via `aria-describedby`, Enter submits, focus/input stay mounted across success and failure, `role="status"` for saving/saved, status carried by text not colour.

## Commands run (from the repo root)
- `corepack pnpm --filter '@ji/web-app' test` → **28 files / 204 tests passed, 0 failed** (baseline was 199; the 5 new tests are included). One intermediate failure during development (a zh-CN assertion racing the initial load) was fixed and the final run is clean.
- `corepack pnpm --filter '@ji/web-app' exec tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit` → **exit 0**. (The primary form `tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json` is equivalent; I used the fallback form you authorised.)

## Deliberately left out
- **Browser/UI verification** of the section (deep link `/settings/hosts/local-host/general`): it needs a build or dev server, both outside the commands you allowed. Per `docs/rules/ui-interaction.md` §10 this still needs a run against the real Host.
- **No CSS file touched** (constraint is TS/TSX only), so the input and layout use Tailwind utilities per AGENTS.md's frontend policy, with `bg-transparent`/`border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-600` mirroring `ui/textarea.tsx` and the muted text token `var(--ji-text-muted)` so dark-mode contrast is not regressed. If you prefer a `styles.css` rule, that is a follow-up.
- **No Relay/HCP rename path**: `renameHost` is REST-only, because §9.1 of ch.18 makes the entry loopback-only and the remote view must not offer it. The `remote` case shows the id as read-only rather than fetching it over Relay.
- **`App.test.tsx` untouched**: its ~15 `/api/v1/host` mocks still omit `hostIdRevision`, so on that page the revision renders as an empty value. Nothing fails, but those mocks are now behind the contract — worth updating when your Java change lands.
- Note: `git status` also shows modified `contracts/errors/catalog.json`, `contracts/generated/**` and `docs/java-rewrite/generated/error-catalog.md` — those are your error-catalog regeneration (task #1), not mine; I wrote to none of them.
